race.comment: OUTSIDETHESQUARE (8) is a lightly raced type who won her maiden well here two back over this route, tackling a stronger race at Pakenham Synthetic last start when fading. Open to further improvement at fourth start and can bounce back. BERTRAND (4) returns from a spell of five months and tackles a synthetic surface for the first time. He showed ability last time in and maps ideally on speed, consider. PICK WISELY (9) is stuck on 1 win from 15 starts but is going consistently, just finding one better over this route last time out. Drawn well and has claims. SWYCHO (5) is coming off a win here in similar company and turns around quickly, she should take catching again. NEWCOMBE (7) is consistent and should be right there.
